answer: Stop sybils at the island, not the gate. Every identity is an island that must earn passage across a lagoon: to speak, it locks sable, sand that dissolves grain by grain into the lagoon, so one stake cannot be reused across a clone. Weight flows only when an unrelated island vouches across open water, and each vouch is priced by how many vouches already came from the same funder, so the k-th clone pays k times more sable. If one island in a lineage is caught cheating, the whole lineage's sable is dredged and burned at once: N clones lose about N squared, and no botnet can amortize that.
